name: Sarah: Debt Consolidation
description: Sarah wants to consolidate her credit card debt. This lowers her monthly payments and utilization. Strong approval case.

name: Sarah: Home Improvement
description: Sarah wants a large loan for renovations. This creates a new $1000+ monthly obligation which pushes her DTI too high given her moderate income.

name: David: Yacht Purchase
description: David has high income ($175k). Even with a $100k loan, his DTI remains acceptable. High Earner Exception applies if close to limits.

name: David: Investment Property
description: David tries to leverage too much. The $1M loan adds huge debt service, pushing DTI well above 50%. Too risky.

name: Maria: Business Expansion
description: Maria has a thin file (650 score). The loan is for business growth. This requires manual underwriting to verify business cash flow.

name: Gary: Borderline Credit (Escalation)
description: Gary has a 620 score, high DTI (65%), and a recent late payment. This is too risky for auto-approval but not a hard decline. Requires senior review.

name: Jane: Missing Info (Q&A)
description: Jane's application is incomplete (No Stated Income). The agent should NOT decline, but instead ASK the user for the missing info.
